commands.command: design: EmergencyStopController implements LLD 4.3's approved NORMAL->STOPPING->STOPPED->RESET_PENDING->NORMAL machine under a real threading.RLock, so activate()/guard_dispatch() cannot race each other; guard_dispatch fails closed unless the system is NORMAL AND the presented fencing epoch equals the current one exactly -- a command fenced to any other epoch, older or from a prior stop/reset cycle, can never dispatch. confirm_reset always issues a brand-new epoch, so a reset never silently re-enables a lease or command fenced to the pre-stop epoch, structurally realizing 'non riabilita lease precedenti'. Reset itself requires two distinct, resolved human approvers.

design: BreakGlassController implements LLD 4.2's bounded, dual-human-approved exceptional grant: BreakGlassGrant requires a typed reason, an incident reference, a minimal scope, exactly two distinct resolved human approvers, and a TTL bounded by MAX_BREAK_GLASS_TTL (15 minutes, per ADD 5.5). authorize() is a pure function of (grant, capability, at) re-run on every use -- an expired grant, a revoked one, one requesting a capability on the fixed FORBIDDEN_BREAK_GLASS_CAPABILITIES denylist (create a Decision, reduce marking, disable provenance/audit, ignore emergency stop, change the release pin, authorize R3 without quorum, access outside compartment), or one used while an emergency stop is active, is refused every time, never only at grant time. Every successful use requires a non-empty review_ref, making the LLD's 'review obbligatoria' structural rather than merely documented.

design: OutcomeReconciler implements the ACT-T18a/T18b/T20a-c/T21-T21e/T24/T25 ambiguous-outcome and compensation reconciliation path: mark_ambiguous/mark_compensation_ambiguous open reconciliation; resolve_with_evidence resolves to confirmed/failed or compensated/compensation-failed only from a resolvable (UNKNOWN/COMPENSATION_UNKNOWN) state; escalate_if_deadline_passed makes no inference before the deadline and escalates to INDETERMINATE/COMPENSATION_INDETERMINATE (opening adjudication) only once it has genuinely passed; require_may_auto_retry is the task's own core negative claim made executable -- an ambiguous or indeterminate outcome whose effect is not proven idempotent can never be auto-retried, matching LLD 6's 'retry solo... con idempotency comprovata'.

residual_risks: This task builds the smallest contract-compliant slice of stop-epoch fencing, break-glass, and ambiguous-outcome reconciliation as independent, composable primitives; it does not itself wire guard_dispatch/require_may_auto_retry calls into GovernedActionEngine.execute (OCOR-DEV-0030) or the FSM's own dispatch-adjacent transitions (OCOR-DEV-0042) -- a future integration task would call these guards from the real dispatch path, the same way OCOR-DEV-0043's HumanGateCoordinator composes into GovernedActionEngine.execute without engine.py itself changing.

The FORBIDDEN_BREAK_GLASS_CAPABILITIES denylist is a fixed frozenset of capability-name strings matching the LLD's own named restrictions; it does not itself enforce e.g. 'accedere fuori compartment' at the marking-lattice level (that remains C4's own marking-safe projection responsibility, reused elsewhere in this session) -- break-glass here only refuses the capability-name-level restrictions the LLD names explicitly.

OutcomeReconciler's reconciliation-deadline handling (escalate_if_deadline_passed) requires the caller to supply the deadline explicitly on each call rather than tracking it internally per command; a future integration would need to persist and pass the correct deadline consistently.

The pre-existing local-venv gap noted in prior evidence (uv cannot resolve the exact 3.12.11 interpreter in this sandbox) is unchanged and out of this task's scope; it produces the same 2 pre-existing, unrelated regression failures documented in every prior evidence file this session.
